reviews.text: Excellent first experience at Les Trésors. The welcome was very pleasant and reassuring. Mochi was pampered and the result was perfect. Thank you so much!

A huge thank you to the team for their kindness and professionalism! Our wirehaired dachshund is magnificent, we are thrilled!! We are so happy to have finally found a reliable place, we will definitely be back and highly recommend them!

Super A'Paco, one year old, is a toy poodle.
He's great every time.
I love you very much.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Bambi. She came home completely transformed from that appointment. You are truly amazing!

I highly recommend you!

A very warm welcome. I called in the early afternoon to ask for advice about my dog's nails. The person I spoke to was very attentive and was able to see me the same day. As my dog ​​is timid, the staff took the time to let her get used to the place and feel comfortable with them. They were very gentle, reassuring, and attentive, both to my dog ​​and to me. My dog ​​arrived slightly scared and left transformed, confident and at ease. I will definitely return and highly recommend them.

I entrusted my Spitz to Thalia and I am absolutely delighted with the result. She gave him a magnificent, meticulous, and precise grooming that perfectly highlights my little darling. You can immediately feel her professionalism and gentle touch in every movement.

The welcome was just as remarkable: warm, attentive, and very reassuring. Thalia takes the time to listen, explain, and put the animal at ease, which makes all the difference.

A truly pleasant experience, both for me and my baby. I recommend her without hesitation.

I visited this salon over a month ago and I wanted to say a huge thank you to Thalia, a lovely and passionate groomer!

Initially, I just came in for a basic trim, as I'd never really been offered a cut before… but Thalia suggested I try an Asian cut, which she thought would be more suitable for my dog's features. And she was absolutely right!

The result is simply stunning: my little guy is unrecognizable, while still retaining his natural charm. The cut perfectly highlights his head and his eyes, and I've literally fallen in love with this style!! I won't change it for anything else; it's the perfect cut for him.

In addition to being very professional, Thalia is incredibly gentle with animals and always listens to the owners. You can tell she loves what she does and puts her whole heart into every grooming session. Thank you again!
Excellent service in the Marais district… thank you 🤩 …

Amazing cat grooming salon!
Thank you, Eddy!
Avoid at all costs

First time at this groomer today and honestly, it was perfect! The team was super friendly, welcoming, and very generous. They gave our dog Dipper a really great haircut; the result is impeccable. They even gave him a little ice cream at the end, which was such a sweet touch. We're thrilled with this first experience and will definitely be back. Thanks again!

I’m so happy I’ve found this place!

Excellent service, the girls are so sweet and professional. My dog came out like new and super happy.

A superb place, with a caring and trustworthy team. It took me a long time to find a groomer I could trust, and this place met the challenge. A special thank you to Talia, an expert, gentle with animals, and full of great advice! She truly loves animals and takes excellent care of them. Thank you ❤️

My cat had his first appointment for a nail trim, which is usually done at the vet's (I can't manage it myself because my cat turns into a demon when anyone touches his paws).
So it's always a slightly stressful experience, and the vet usually has to bring extra help to manage all his paws. But at Les Tresors Pets, it was a completely different experience! The owner was incredibly gentle, calming the cat down, and was able to trim his nails smoothly, without any scratches or bites, in complete calm. I'm blown away!

Truly one of the best grooming salons in Paris! They really take the animal's needs and well-being into account. A professional and welcoming team. Toothless, who is usually fearful and aggressive with strangers, trusts them completely!

Absolutely perfect! I brought in my wire-haired miniature dachshund asking for a cut that would keep his round face nice and round, without the classic dachshund cut, and the result is exactly what I wanted. The cut was done with great care and precision; my dog ​​looks magnificent 😍

In addition to being highly skilled, the team is incredibly gentle with the animals and especially lovely with the owners. Thank you ❤️
Excellent grooming and service! Thalia was so wonderful to my dog, she was very helpful with my questions and the outcome is gorgeous. We will definitely be back!

My little one came out looking fantastic! He smelled wonderful and his fur was shiny and soft.
They are incredibly kind and gentle.
I highly recommend them.
Very professional.
Thank you!

Thank you, Thomas, for your rating! 😊 We look forward to seeing you again soon.
Les Trésors Pets - Marais …

Thank you to Talia for her professionalism; she was very pleasant and understood our expectations perfectly, fixing a haircut that had been very poorly done elsewhere. I highly recommend her; my doll got her hair back looking beautiful!
